from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Judgment(BaseModel):
    """Represents one judgment document with its core legal characteristics."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title or identifier of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书1》')")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal domain of the case (e.g., '刑事', '民事', '行政', '执行')")
    legal_issues: list[str] = Field(description="List of core legal issues, charges, or disputes identified in the document (e.g., '盗窃罪', '房屋征收', '离婚')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[Judgment]
